what: Negative controls for the cube certification pipeline (cube_certify.py + cube_exhaustive.py), run 2026-08-04 against kissat 4.0.1 and drat-trim. A checker that says VERIFIED on everything proves nothing: each control below must FAIL, and each failure was OBSERVED, not assumed. Verbatim key fields from the actual runs.

controls.setup: cube_certify.py --n 45 --j 8 --targets 3 4 --k 6 --limit 1 --negctl-truncate 0: the hardest cube's DRAT proof truncated to half before drat-trim sees it

observed.drat_trim_output: c ERROR: no conflict / s NOT VERIFIED

controls.setup: cube_exhaustive.py --n 57 --j 12 --targets 3 4 --k 8 --drop-cube 1,1,2,1,1,2,2,2: one genuine cube deleted from the 4487-cube set before the exhaustiveness walk
controls.expected: FAIL naming the missing prefix, exit 1

observed.why: full-depth prefix neither in the cube set nor refuted by the formula

controls.setup: cube_certify.py --n 32 --j 4 --targets 3 4 --k 4 (one below the published a(4)=33, so a colouring exists)
controls.expected: SAT reported loudly, whole run aborted, exit 2, never VERIFIED

controls.setup: cube_certify.py --n 56 --j 12 --targets 3 4 --k 8 --only 2,0,2,1,2,2,1,2 (the k=8 prefix of the known n=56 witness colouring in cert_n56.txt; n=56 is the SAT side of the headline pair)

positive_composition_check_at_headline_s.setup: cube_exhaustive.py --n 57 --j 12 --targets 3 4 --k 8 (composition/exhaustiveness ONLY; per-cube obligations are a separate 4487-proof run)
positive_composition_check_at_headline_s.observed: 4487 cubes matched, 662 mono-AP drops, 0 UP drops, 0 budget drops, 2574 internal nodes, 3236 tail lemmas; drat-trim on F' + tail: s VERIFIED in 0.08 s
positive_composition_check_at_headline_s.matches_design_prediction: 662 dropped nodes / 3236 lemmas / ~0.1 s, exactly as the design phase measured
